description: This file implements a WebSocket server for real-time communication in the Focalboard project, handling client connections, subscriptions to teams and blocks, and broadcasting updates such as blocks, categories, boards, members, and configurations.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket server managing client connections, subscriptions, and broadcasting updates.

classes.name: websocketSession
classes.description: Represents a client WebSocket session, including connection details and subscriptions.

methods.name: WriteJSON
methods.description: Sends a JSON-encoded message to the WebSocket client.

methods.name: isSubscribedToTeam
methods.description: Checks if the session is subscribed to a specific team.

methods.name: isSubscribedToBlock
methods.description: Checks if the session is subscribed to a specific block.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the session is authenticated.

methods.name: NewServer
methods.description: Creates a new WebSocket server instance.

methods.name: RegisterRoutes
methods.description: Registers WebSocket route.

methods.name: handleWebSocket
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection upgrade and message processing.

methods.name: isCommandReadTokenValid
methods.description: Validates read token and block IDs for commands.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a WebSocket session to the server.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket session and its subscriptions from the server.

methods.name: subscribeListenerToTeam
methods.description: Subscribes a session to a team.

methods.name: unsubscribeListenerFromTeam
methods.description: Unsubscribes a session from a team.

methods.name: subscribeListenerToBlocks
methods.description: Subscribes a session to multiple blocks.

methods.name: unsubscribeListenerFromBlocks
methods.description: Unsubscribes a session from multiple blocks.

methods.name: removeListenerFromTeam
methods.description: Removes a session from a team's subscription list.

methods.name: removeListenerFromBlock
methods.description: Removes a session from a block’s subscription list.

methods.name: getUserIDForToken
methods.description: Retrieves user ID associated with a token.

methods.name: authenticateListener
methods.description: Authenticates a WebSocket session using a token.

methods.name: getListenersForBlock
methods.description: Returns sessions subscribed to a specific block.

methods.name: getListenerForUser
methods.description: Returns the session for a specific user in a team.

methods.name: getListenersForTeamAndBoard
methods.description: Returns sessions subscribed to a team and members of a specific board.

methods.name: BroadcastBlockDelete
methods.description: Broadcasts a block deletion to clients.

methods.name: BroadcastBlockChange
methods.description: Broadcasts a block update to clients.

methods.name: BroadcastCategoryChange
methods.description: Broadcasts a category change to clients.

methods.name: BroadcastCategoryReorder
methods.description: Broadcasts category reorder to clients.

methods.name: BroadcastCategoryBoardsReorder
methods.description: Broadcasts board order change within a category.

methods.name: BroadcastCategoryBoardChange
methods.description: Broadcasts a change in category boards.

methods.name: BroadcastConfigChange
methods.description: Broadcasts configuration changes to clients.

methods.name: BroadcastBoardChange
methods.description: Broadcasts a board change to clients.

methods.name: BroadcastBoardDelete
methods.description: Broadcasts a board deletion.

methods.name: BroadcastMemberChange
methods.description: Broadcasts a member change.

methods.name: BroadcastMemberDelete
methods.description: Broadcasts a member removal.
